objective: Give Fanwire's quiet and empty feed, profile, player-search and records states a consistent original sports visual identity that works without member-uploaded imagery.
acceptance_criteria: Test-first: commit failing tests alone before implementation; tests pin the named empty states, accessible text, SVG treatment, theme behavior and absence of new network requests.

Add one reusable, original code-native SVG/CSS court/scoreboard motif and apply it to the zero-post feed, a public profile with no posts, a player search with no matches, and record groups with no qualifying result; add the concise text 'No posts yet.' to the empty public-profile post area, and do not add artwork to every ordinary text post.

Each state keeps its heading and explanatory text as the accessible source of truth; the motif is decorative with aria-hidden=true and no focusable descendants, and the state continues to distinguish loading, error, empty and zero-result cases.

The motif uses only existing Fanwire color and spacing tokens, has light/dark values, and contains no NBA/league/team/player marks, uniform cues, team-color bars, likenesses, gradients, external assets or added font requests.

Keep SVG code in the frontend source; record it as original project-authored code in the PR. Do not download, generate, or add raster/stock assets. If implementation discovers a raster need, stop and propose a separate Director decision with purpose, rights/provenance, exact dimensions/variants, compression, storage and alt-text behavior.

At 320, 360 and 1280 CSS px, empty-state content remains readable and has no page-level horizontal overflow in light and dark themes; no artwork pushes the primary action below the existing content flow.

Keep existing landmarks, heading levels, focus order, target sizes and status/alert roles. The artwork adds no motion; reduced-motion and forced-colors modes preserve readable text and interactive boundaries.

No new dependency or external network request. Keep the initial JS entry increase within 1 KiB raw and 512 bytes gzip, add at most 2 KiB gzip of shared SVG/style code, and keep all built files below 500,000 raw bytes; include before/after bundle measurements.

Browser evidence covers all four named states at 360 and 1280 in light and dark Chrome/Chromium, checks that the SVG is decorative and no horizontal overflow appears, and labels fixture/override content synthetic.
Update wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md only if the documented empty/loading behavior changed; the context-maintainer role must be able to write that exact file.
